findings.problem: The hint 'think something over' also fits nachdenken (Ich denke darüber nach), a very common verb, so a learner who answers nachdenken could fairly mark themselves right.
findings.fix: hint: think something over, often with mir (ich ___ es mir); not nachdenken

back.target: to consider, to think (something) over, to think about (whether to do something)

note: The other card, überlegen meaning "superior", is an adjective and is stressed differently (ü-ber-LE-gen for the verb, which is inseparable). Its own prompt keeps it apart from this one, so it is no problem.
